cast.name: 弗拉迪米尔·伊瓦绍夫 Vladimir Ivashov
瓦莲京娜·季托娃 Valentina Titova

introduction: The base of the International Space inspection was destroyed as a result of pirate attacks by an unknown military apparatus. Following this, commits suicide president of one of the most powerful Western corporations. However, to prove a direct link between these events were not initially successful. In the area of the proposed framework pirate cruiser sent a spaceship Vaigach. It turned out that one of the planets distant star system biophysicists brilliant scientist who worked on the group, was equipped with a secret research laboratory, were the subject of a study on the creation of artificial intelligence. But the president of the concern, cherishing the dream of creating unreasoning soldiers, ready to fulfill any of its orders, despite the original intention of the scientist has made adjustments to the program development. It is foolish and determined the subsequent withdrawal of the experiment from the control of the researchers: they created an artificial Biocybernetical superbrain, taking possession of instruments of control over the human psyche, completely subjugated the will of their creators and turned them into their puppets ...
